description: World - USGS Undiscovered Oil and Gas Resources is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Resource assessments", published or maintained by Schenk, C.J., Brownfield, M.E., Charpentier, R.R., Cook, T.A., Gautier, D.L., Higley, D.K., Kirschbaum, M.A., Klett, T.R., Pitman, J.K., Pollastro, R.M., Tennyson, M.E., Wandrey, C.J., and Whidden, K.J., (World Conventional Resources Assessment Team) (United States Geological Survey). The Undiscovered Oil and Gas Resources dataset shows the locations of the Assessment Units (AUs) in the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) World Assessment of Undiscovered Oil and Gas Resources. The assessment was conducted in 2012 and evaluated 313 AUs within 171 geologic provinces (areas where oil and gas occur in commercial quantities). Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Resource assessments. The portal gives 2012 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
